Get energized with this 15 minute cardio workout at home! This all-standing cardio workout is a fun way to get your heart pumping, boost your energy, and add more movement to your day — all without getting down on the floor.
This 15 minute standing cardio workout is designed for beginners, older adults, and anyone who wants a fun, low-impact workout that can be done at home. No floor exercises and no complicated moves — just simple, enjoyable movements to help you feel good and get moving.
What to expect:
• 15 minutes of fun, all-standing cardio
• 1667 steps and all low impact
